# yii3-tenancy

Multi-tenancy core for Yii3: tenant resolution (header/subdomain/path),
request-scoped CurrentTenant context, scoping primitives. No ORM auto-scoping.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-tenancy
```

## Rules

- Tenant keys from requests are untrusted: every resolver validates against
  `Tenant::isValidId()` (`/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/`) and returns
  `null` on mismatch.
- The core never binds `TenantProvider` in DI — a backend package or the
  application binds it (exactly one source).
- Place `TenantResolutionMiddleware` BEFORE authentication middleware.
- No implicit default tenant: unresolved → 404 unless `passthrough` policy.
- `TenantScopedCache::clear()` wipes ALL tenants (PSR-16 has no scoped clear).

## API reference

### Tenant (value object)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\Tenant;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\TenantStatus;

$tenant = new Tenant(
    id: 'acme',                        // validated, throws InvalidArgumentException
    name: 'Acme Inc',                  // optional
    status: TenantStatus::Active,      // Active | Suspended
    attributes: ['plan' => 'pro'],     // array<string, mixed>
);
$tenant->isActive();                   // bool
Tenant::isValidId('acme');             // static validation helper
```

### CurrentTenant / RequestCurrentTenant

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\CurrentTenant;         // interface for readers
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\RequestCurrentTenant;  // concrete holder for writers

$current = new RequestCurrentTenant();
$current->set($tenant);        // once per request; second set() throws LogicException
$current->override($tenant);   // explicit replacement (console/tests)
$current->get();               // Tenant, throws TenantNotResolvedException
$current->find();              // ?Tenant
$current->isResolved();        // bool
```

### Resolvers (all implement TenantResolver, return ?string)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\CompositeTenantResolver;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\HeaderTenantResolver;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\PathTenantResolver;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\SubdomainTenantResolver;

new HeaderTenantResolver(headerName: 'X-Tenant-Id');          // default header
new SubdomainTenantResolver(baseDomain: 'example.com');       // acme.example.com -> acme
new PathTenantResolver(prefix: '/t');                         // /t/acme/x -> acme
new CompositeTenantResolver($first, $second);                 // first non-null wins
```

### TenantProvider (swappable backend axis)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\ConfigTenantProvider;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\TenantProvider;       // interface: find(string): ?Tenant

new ConfigTenantProvider([
    'acme' => ['name' => 'Acme Inc', 'status' => 'active', 'attributes' => []],
]);
```

### TenantResolutionMiddleware (PSR-15)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\TenantPolicy;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\TenantResolutionMiddleware;

new TenantResolutionMiddleware(
    resolver: $resolver,
    provider: $provider,
    currentTenant: $requestCurrentTenant,
    responseFactory: $psr17ResponseFactory,
    unresolvedPolicy: TenantPolicy::Reject,     // 404 | PassThrough
    suspendedPolicy: TenantPolicy::Reject,      // 403 | PassThrough
);
// success: publishes to RequestCurrentTenant + Tenant::class request attribute
```

### TenantScopedCache (PSR-16 decorator)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\TenantScopedCache;

$cache = new TenantScopedCache($innerPsr16, $currentTenant);
$cache->set('report', $data);   // stored under "t.{tenantId}.report"
```

### DI (config-plugin)

Ships config/di.php + config/params.php. Binds CurrentTenant, resolvers,
middleware; does NOT bind TenantProvider. Params key: `rasuvaeff/yii3-tenancy`
(`header`, `base_domain`, `path_prefix`, `resolvers`, `unresolved_policy`,
`suspended_policy`).
